title: Syndicate Wars / Ghost in the shell inspired - DEV UPDATE #2 - With a drop of Tiberian Sun and Battlezone?
author: KingQuiet880
selftext:
I always thought in games like Syndicate wars and megalopolis type dystopias what would be outside cities, and I always like wastelands with mysteries and dangers. So I made this showcase - what if you are banished from safe boundaries of the city to the wasteland destroyed by solar flares, wars and others. 

Also, while playing Tiberian sun, I always wished there was more base building option, to form and decorate the base to your liking, but game was to chaotic. One tank rush would level even the terrain, not mention the base. Here I made it more like Battlezone where you are base commander. 

It is still work in progress and some animations are work in progress but I hope you like it. Made it as prototype to see how it would feel to switch from party RTS to base building RTS in same game. I will get back to the city mechanics as in first video now. 

Here is the link to the last one: [DEV UPDATE #1](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1x3m4uz/syndicate_wars_ghost_in_the_shell_inspired_dev/)
